name: Summer peak: Max Gen escalation
description: MISO escalates from Capacity Advisory to a Max Gen Event. Every site reacts at once, staggered by its ramp-rate cap. One site loses its Membrane link mid-event and still ends at firm with the line energized.

beats.title: Predict
beats.text: P10 headroom at Sub-Marion Northwest falls below site need in 45 min. Max Gen escalation likely.

beats.title: Max Gen Alert
beats.text: Sites are pre-positioned: batteries full, deferral queue ready. Flexible work still runs on grid headroom.

beats.title: Max Gen Warning
beats.text: Flexible load is stepped down ahead of any call.

beats.title: Max Gen Event
beats.text: Every contracted site steps to its firm limit. Each step is confirmed by the utility meter.

beats.title: Eagle Creek Cloud lost its Membrane link
beats.text: Local controller holds firm. The feeder stays energized and AES SCADA keeps reporting the meter.

beats.title: Max Gen Alert (de-escalated)
beats.text: MISO steps down. Sites resume flexible load within ramp caps where the P10 forecast allows.

beats.title: All clear
beats.text: Jobs have resumed. Batteries recharge overnight.

callouts.text: P10 headroom at Sub-Marion Northwest below site need in 45 min — 78%
Max Gen Event likely within 30 minutes
Max Gen Event: all sites at firm, confirmed by utility meters
